baseline.description: A perturbation changes expression by the sum of its genes' single-gene changes in training (additive model).

lineage.hypothesis: LASSO on baseline features (control mean, mean response, target indicator).

Adding additive model of the single-gene responses: each target gene's training single response (the mean single-gene response for a gene without one), summed over the perturbation's genes improves prediction of unseen perturbations.
Drop mean_response from the best model (EXP_0015) to test whether it still earns its place.
Fit the best feature set (EXP_0022) with lasso instead of ridge.
Add response_components_e14 to the best model (EXP_0025): it helped elsewhere and the best model lacks it.
Drop control_mean from the best model (EXP_0027) to test whether it still earns its place.
Fit the best feature set (EXP_0033) with ridge instead of lasso.
Add target_level_e11 to the best model (EXP_0038) although it did not help where it was first tried.
Refine the ridge penalty around alpha=100 for the best model (EXP_0042).
Refine the ridge penalty around alpha=300 for the best model (EXP_0045).
Refine the ridge penalty around alpha=900 for the best model (EXP_0049).
Refine the ridge penalty around alpha=2700 for the best model (EXP_0054).
Refine the ridge penalty around alpha=8100 for the best model (EXP_0058).

most_useful_features.description: Additive model of single-gene responses: the sum over p's target genes of each gene's single-gene training response (the mean response of the other training perturbations whose one target is that gene), with the mean single-gene training response for a gene without one.

Low-rank response components of the training perturbations (leave-one-out SVD of their centred delta profiles); p's weight on each component is predicted by kernel ridge from its target's annotations (gene-set memberships, protein interactions, TF-network partners). One column per component.
Response of g averaged over the k training perturbations whose targets are most co-expressed with p's targets (leave-one-out).
Control mean expression of g if g is the perturbed target, else 0.
Control-cell correlation between the perturbed target gene and gene g.
Control-cell standard deviation of gene g.
